answers.question: How long does an SMP treatment take?
answers.text: SMP is performed in 2 to 4 sessions, spaced 7–14 days apart. Each session lasts about 2–3 hours.

answers.question: Does SMP hurt?
answers.text: The treatment is slightly uncomfortable, but most clients describe it as a scratching sensation. Local anesthesia is not used, except upon client request.

answers.question: How long does the SMP effect last?
answers.text: The result of scalp micropigmentation lasts 2 to 4 years, after which a touch-up session is recommended.

answers.question: Is SMP the same as a tattoo?
answers.text: No. SMP uses special pigments, finer needles, and shallower insertion depth. It doesn’t blur or change color like regular tattoos.

answers.question: What does the result look like for bald men?
answers.text: The effect of micropigmentation looks like a clean-shaved head. The pigment imitates hair follicles and follows the natural head shape.

answers.question: Is there a visible difference between pigment and real hair?
answers.text: If performed professionally – no. The pigment tone is selected to match your natural hair and skin color.

answers.question: Do I need to shave my head if I just have thinning hair?
answers.text: No. During this treatment, your natural hair length is preserved while pigment fills lighter gaps.

answers.question: Can I combine SMP with a hair transplant?
answers.text: Yes. Micropigmentation is often done after transplantation to enhance density and fill gaps.

answers.question: Can pigment be applied to a scar?
answers.text: Yes – scalp micropigmentation effectively conceals scars after transplant (FUE/FUT) as well as those caused by injury or surgery.

answers.question: Is SMP safe on scar tissue?
answers.text: Yes, but the treatment is done carefully and in layers – after evaluating the skin condition.
